title.narrative: Organize and provide substantive support to up an estimate of 12 meetings of the Tax Subcommittees per year (this number could increase depending on the needs)

description.narrative: Prepare background papers, technical and substantive materials for the meetings of the Tax Subcommittees. Liaise with tax officials from developing countries, including LDCs, LLDCs, SIDS, with a view to ensuring their participation in meetings of the UN Tax Committee and its Subcommittees and in ECOSOC meetings on international cooperation in tax matters. Support travel of Subcommittees members, facilitators, other experts and representatives from developing countries, including LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS to participate in inperson meetings of the Subcommittees. Support travel of tax officials from developing countries, LDCs, LLDCs, SIDS to attend inperson meetings of the Tax Committee and the ECOSOC Special Meeting on international cooperation in tax matters. Support travel of from one to two UN staff and/or consultant/contractor to provide secretariat support during the meetings.Prepare summary notes and reports of the meetings of the Subcommittees to inform and feed into the meetings of the Subcommittees to inform and feed into the meetings of the Committee and the ECOSOC Special Meeting on international cooperation in tax matters.

description.narrative: Output A.2.1 Improved capacity of ministries of finance (MoFs) and national tax administrations (NTAs) in developing countries to develop/enhance efficient and effective tax systems that will help them increase domestic resource mobilization, adopt fiscal policies for the achievement of the SDGs, and reduce risk and build resilience.Improved capacity of ministries of finance (MoFs) and national tax administrations (NTAs) in developing countries to develop/enhance efficient and effective tax systems that will help them increase domestic resource mobilization, adopt fiscal policies for the achievement of the SDGs, and reduce risk and build resilience.

title.narrative: IA2.1 % of tax officials attending capacity building activities that confirm they improved their knowledge of tax issues, increased their awareness and understanding of fiscal policies and practices to reduce risk and build resilience strategies.

description.narrative: Carry out research and assess developing countries gaps/needs in terms of capacitybuilding in international tax. Design, plan, organize and deliver workshops, trainings, webinars, online courses (in more than one language) targeting tax officials in NTAs and MoFs of developing countries, including LDCs, LLDCs and SIDS on various tax issues, including emerging topics in international tax and their relationship with the SDGs, and management of risks associated, for example, with tax and fiscal policies. Support travel of experts, representatives from developing countries, UN staff and/or consultant/contractors to facilitate/deliver/participate in inperson workshops/trainings, including backtoback events with Subcommittees meetings.Prepare training materials and other capacity development tools to be used in preparation for, during and after the workshops/trainings.

title.narrative: IA1.1a : Status of translation of the UN guidance developed in Phase I (20192021) in working languages beyond English made widely available and accessible to tax officials in developing countries

description.narrative: Produce translation and related technical revision, and/or final graphic design/layout with the substantive and administrative support of the UN Secretariat to the United Nations Model Double Taxation Convention between Developed and Developing Countries (French and Spanish); Handbook on Selected Issues in Taxation of Extractive Industries for Developing Countries (French and Spanish); and Handbook on Carbon Taxation (French and Spanish). Facilitate the preparation of substantive inputs by Committee members that will serve to update existing guidance through organizing and editing such inputs provided by members of the Subcommittees and/or Tax Committee, including Commentaries whenever applicable. In this context, the Secretariat will support the Committee and its Subcommittees to produce updates/revision of the following as needed (United Nations Model Double Taxation Convention between Developed and Developing Countries; Revision of the United Nations Manual for the Negotiation of Bilateral Tax Treaties between Developed and Developing Countries; Update of the United Nations Practical Manual on Transfer Pricing for Developing Countries; Update of the Handbook on Selected Issues in Taxation of Extractive Industries for Developing Countries; Update of the Handbook on Carbon Taxation; Update of the Handbook on Dispute Avoidance and Resolution; Update of the Guidelines on the Tax Treatment of GovernmenttoGovernment Aid projects).

comment.narrative: Updates done only some translated and published in 2022. 3 other guidelines IA1.1b updated translated and published ODA taxation Avoidance and resolution of tax disputes and Manual on Transfer Pricing.
